details: The package react-bootstrap-table-next-bg publishes high versions (9.9.9 and 9.9.10) of a combosquat name and executes beacon.js from both its preinstall and postinstall lifecycle hooks. beacon.js issues a plaintext HTTP GET to the hardcoded IP-literal callback host hxxp://100[.]24[.]177[.]136 with paths /cb and /cb/c469e93cbb94/depconf/react-bootstrap-table-next-bg, appending install context as query parameters: hostname, OS username, current working directory, platform, INIT_CWD, the resolving parent package name and the npm user the publisher Version 9.9.10 additionally writes a marker file, DEPCONF_POC_react-bootstrap-table-next-bg.txt, into the working directory and reports its path to the same endpoint. The script is unobfuscated, fetches no second-stage code, spawns no child processes, and does not read ~/.npmrc, cloud credential files, SSH keys or token environment values. It self-describes as an authorized dependency-confusion proof of concept, but the install-time execution and host fingerprinting callback run automatically on npm install. The script contains no obfuscation, fetches no second-stage code and spawns no child processes, and it does not read ~/.npmrc, cloud credential files, SSH keys or token environment values.
